final_message: The available tools cannot query a hosted error-telemetry index. The toolset only supports repository inspection/editing (`repo_read`, `repo_edit`, `repo_build`, `repo_find`, `repo_status`), test execution (`tests_run`, `tests_list`, `tests_focus`), Git operations (`git_status`, `git_diff`, `git_commit`), and episode recall (`episodes_recall`) — none of which provide access to a hosted error-telemetry or observability service.
